description: Frozen database baseline. Every value here is a claim the migration-replay job re-proves from an empty PostgreSQL 17 on every run. A value that changes legitimately must be raised in the SAME commit that changes the schema, so the diff shows both.

forbiddenMigrationPrefixNote: Migration 120 belongs to the next authorised phase. Its presence on this branch means phase work has leaked into an unrelated change.
schemaHashNote: Produced by `npm run validate:schema-inventory -- --hash-only`. Unchanged from P1-18 through P1-21; the inventory backend added no migration.
structuralTotalsNote: DELIBERATELY EMPTY. The counts recorded in earlier phase gates came from scripts/db/schema-inventory.mjs, which counts differently from the catalog queries in scripts/ci/migration-replay-checks.mjs. Copying those numbers across would compare two things that were never the same measurement. The first GitHub-hosted run records this script's own totals; they are then committed and enforced.
seededStructuralTablesNote: DELIBERATELY NULL. Structural catalogs inside business schemas (work-order states, units of measure, payment methods) are legitimately seeded, but the exact list has never been enumerated from a clean database. Until it is recorded here the check reports the measurement and passes; once recorded, a NEW populated business table becomes a failure.
